name: comp-232

frames.best_why: The panel is open with continent headings and their flag-led country rows, no cursor in the list.

tagline: Countries grouped by continent, each row led by its flag.
summary: A searchable country picker whose list is split into continent headings, with a flag before every name. Choosing a country closes the panel and fills the trigger with its flag and name.
appearance: A small label sits above a wide rounded trigger reading Select country with a chevron. Opened, a dark panel shows a search field, then small grey continent headings with rows of a flag emoji and a country name.
behaviour: Clicking the trigger opens the panel; typing filters rows and their headings, and choosing one closes the panel and updates the trigger. The clip searches japan and ends on Japan.
demo_content: Select country; groups America, Africa, Asia, Europe and Oceania with rows such as United States, Canada and Japan
search_phrases: select your country in a form
country selector with a search box
use_when: In an address or signup form, when people must find one country quickly from a long list.
avoid_when: Flags render differently on each platform, and only fourteen countries are included, so a real list needs new data.
customise: Countries are grouped in an array in the file, each with a flag and a name; add or edit entries there. The continent headings, placeholder and trigger width are set in the same file.
weight_why: Fourteen short grouped rows in a popup with one brief open animation.

a11y.note: The trigger is a labelled combobox and filtering works from the keyboard; each flag sits inside the option text, so its emoji name may be read as well.

issues: Only fourteen countries appear across five groups, so the list is far from a complete picker.
The field label is the demo phrase Options with flag and search, not a real field name.
polish_why: Clear continent grouping and tidy flag rows; the data covers only a token set of countries.
title: Flag Country Combobox
